evidence.name: Screen field: Fixed image width
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Fixed image width" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Fixed image width
sections.description: Optionally pin the hero image to a set width with the slider (0–500) or by typing a number. Leave it empty in most cases — the image then sizes to the screen and stays responsive across devices, which almost always looks best on a landing page. Set a fixed width only when you need the image smaller than full-width or aligned to a specific size.
